en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2142 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:

"Whoever looks at the Kaaba, recognizing its sanctity and our right and sanctity as they recognize its right and its sanctity, then Allah (swt) will forgive all their sins and suffice them in their concerns of this world and the Hereafter."
